sentence: Raisch and Krakowski's argument that the two applications cannot be kept apart in practice reads, after this corpus, like a job description for management: the moderators of Section , from leadership support to managerial capability, describe the people who draw that line, and firms with stronger management teams pull more value out of the same investment
passage: [Shi et al. (2025), p. 1] "The findings establish that managerial capability positively moderates this relationship, indicating that firms with stronger management teams extract greater value from AI investments."
